name: shopil-plugin
description: Jira-aware Git workflows, Conventional Commits, Ponytail, and a source-indexed ShopIL course kit.

interface.shortDescription: Ticket-linked branches, commits, tests, and ShopIL context
interface.longDescription: Work from Jira acceptance criteria using Ponytail, native hooks, local Git checks, CI conventions, and bundled ShopIL assignment and course references. Jira mutations use your connected Atlassian tools. GitHub protection is configured separately.
defaultPrompt: Use ShopIL Plugin to implement my ShopIL ticket.
Install workflow checks in this repository.
